name: Shorn One
subtitle: Tlaloc's Oathsworn
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: In the most prestigious warrior society of Omeyocan, the Shorn Ones are battlefield terrors. Easily identified—bald but for a single braid and painted in blues and reds or yellows—they are merciless not only to the enemy but to any of their own who dare retreat. Facing Shorn Ones means death for one side or the other; they permit no other outcome.
